name: Anaki
description: An elf who drained mana from the forest to destroy water dragons and taught her technique to Turul.

description_citations.text: "Tapestries". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anaki and Turul's son Akkurdal abuses mana draining, creating the Great Waste and becoming the Wizard Tyrant; his granddaughter vows to kill him.
timeline.quote: and he is known as the Wizard Tyrant.

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "Wellspring , by Cynthia Ward". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
